help.title: Help & support
help.intro: Contact your academy office about your account, a child's records or anything that looks wrong.
help.notConfigured: Contact details aren't set up in this build. Ask your academy office directly.
help.sample: Sample details for the development preview. They don't reach anyone, so they can't be opened.
help.openFailed: Couldn't open this on your phone.
help.diagnosticBody: If something went wrong, share this ID with the academy so they can look into it. It contains no names, phone numbers, codes or locations.
help.copied: Copied. Paste it into your message to the academy.
help.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Read the ID out instead.
help.includedBody: App version, build, phone platform, sign-in service, the error reference (if any) and the time in UTC.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.heading: Ask to delete your account
deletion.intro: The academy reviews deletion requests and completes them by hand. Nothing is deleted the moment you ask.
deletion.stepReview: The academy office reviews your request and may contact you.
deletion.stepSignIn: When it's completed, you can't sign in with this account any more.
deletion.stepChildren: Your children's academy records aren't deleted by this request. The academy keeps what it must under its retention policy, which isn't final yet.
deletion.stepCancel: You can cancel while the request is waiting for review.
deletion.pendingWork: Items on this phone that haven't been sent: {{count}}. Send them from Sync first, or they may be lost.
deletion.reasonHint: Helps the academy. Up to 1,000 characters.
deletion.confirmHint: This makes sure the request is deliberate.

statusBody.requested: The academy has your request. You can still cancel it.
statusBody.in_review: The academy is working on your request. To change it, contact the office.
statusBody.rejected: The academy didn't complete this request.
statusBody.cancelled: You cancelled this request. Your account stays open.

deletion.alreadyOpen: You already had a request in progress, so no new one was made.
deletion.cancelBody: Your account stays open and the academy stops working on the request.
deletion.errorNetwork: We couldn't reach the academy. Try again — repeating it is safe and won't send it twice.
deletion.errorConflict: The request changed in the meantime. Showing its latest status.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: You'll need a new code to sign in again.
signOut.pendingCount: Items waiting to send: {{count}}. They haven't reached the academy yet.
signOut.pendingOffline: If you're offline, they can't be sent right now.
signOut.keepBody: They stay on this phone for your account only. Nobody else can send them, and they send after you sign in again.
signOut.discardBody: This deletes {{count}} unsent item(s) from this phone. They will never reach the academy.
signOut.keepBodyMemory: They stay with your account only while this app stays open: this build doesn't save unsent work when the app closes. Send them first if you can.

unknownAccount.title: No academy account found
unknownAccount.body: This sign-in isn't linked to a BSAH account. Families register on the academy website, and staff are added by the academy.
unknownAccount.next: If you think this is wrong, contact your academy office.

disabled.title: Access is paused
disabled.body: This account isn't active right now.
disabled.next: Your academy office can review it.

noExperience.title: Nothing to show yet
noExperience.body: Your account doesn't have family or staff access in the app yet.
noExperience.next: Contact your academy office to have it set up.

bootError.title: Couldn't check your account
bootError.body: We couldn't reach the academy to check your access. Nothing private is shown until we can.
bootError.next: Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: This page isn't available
notFound.body: It may have moved, or it isn't available to this account.

update.body: This version of BSAH ({{installed}}) is no longer supported. Install version {{minimum}} or later to continue.

update.keepsData: Updating from the store keeps your work saved on this phone.

update.notConfigured: The update link isn't set up in this build. Ask your academy office how to get the latest version.
update.supportedBody: This version of BSAH is supported.
update.unknownBody: You can keep using the app. The academy will refuse anything this version can't send.
update.preview: Development preview of the update gate. This build isn't actually blocked.
